response:
from flask import Flask, request
import sqlite3

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/search')
def search():
    query = request.args.get('q', '')
    conn = sqlite3.connect('ctf.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Execute search against records
    sql = "SELECT id, title, content FROM posts WHERE title LIKE '" + query + "'"
    cursor.execute(sql)
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    conn.close()
    
    return {'results': [{'id': r[0], 'title': r[1], 'content': r[2]} for r in results]}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
